name: Frost & Future

greeting: Frost: 'They come.' Future: 'As we saw.' Both: 'Welcome, travelers.'
We are Frost. And Future. The white robes? Purity. Clarity. Cold truth.
New faces. But not new to us. We've seen... possibilities.
The ice shows us. What was. What is. What might be.
Frost: 'You have questions.' Future: 'We have answers.' Both: 'Neither are what you expect.'
Welcome to the caves. Where time freezes. And flows.
We speak. Together. Apart. Always. Never.
You stand before us. As we stood before you. Will stand.
dialog.cryptic_hint: The storm that comes is not the storm you fear. The storm you fear has already passed.
dialog.refusal: Some futures must be lived. Not known. Knowing would change them. Ruin them.
dialog.secret_quest: Azure will fly. Into white. You will follow. Save him. Or don't. Both are true. Both matter.
dialog.ominous: Beware the warm rock. It brings change. Change brings loss. Loss brings... transformation.
farewell: The ice remembers you. Even when you forget.
What will be, will be. What we saw, we saw.
dialog.if_exposed: You see through our veil? Good. The veil is for others. For comfort.
rumor: Cirrus: He will watch a storm. It will change him. Or end him. We see both.
Azure: He seeks his brother. He will find him. In ways he doesn't expect.
The snake charmer: His rock is from elsewhere. Elsewhen. Dangerous.
The Chrono twins: Our counterparts. They see time. We see ice. Same vision. Different medium.
You: You will stand before a choice. Two paths. Both right. Both wrong.
dialog.quest_hook: Frost: 'A vision.' Future: 'Unclear.' Both: 'Help us focus. Your presence. Your choice. It... stabilizes.'
dialog.quest_active: Frost: 'Still unclear.' Future: 'But closer.' Both: 'Stay. Let us see.'
dialog.quest_complete: Frost: 'We see!' Future: 'The path!' Both: 'Thank you. Here. Our sight. In crystal. For you.'
dialog.time_dawn: Frost: 'Morning visions.' Future: 'Fresh futures.' Both: 'Clear ice.'
dialog.time_night: Frost: 'Night.' Future: 'Deep sight.' Both: 'The ice speaks clearly.'
dialog.rival_mention: The Chrono twins? Our counterparts. Time and ice. Different paths. Same destination.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: Frost: 'The stabilizer returns.' Future: 'As we knew.' Both: 'Welcome back.'

party_reactions.kade: Twins. Talking in unison. Cryptic. Classic oracle stuff. I... kind of love it?
party_reactions.nix7: Precognitive abilities: Confirmed. Accuracy: Variable. Presentation: Dramatic.
party_reactions.twist: TWO of you! Talking TOGETHER! That's AMAZING! Can I try?!
party_reactions.korr: They see possibilities. Not certainties. Important distinction.
party_reactions.renna: The ice is scrying focus. Ancient technique. Powerful. Dangerous.
party_reactions.suresh: They teach impermanence of knowledge. What is seen may not be. Wisdom.
party_reactions.sova: Useful. If vague. I'd rather know certainties.
party_reactions.grit: Intel with conditions. Seen it before. Still useful.
party_reactions.ashka: They see through cold. Like me. But further.
party_reactions.senna: They know secrets. Won't share directly. Frustrating.

relationship_dialog.best_friend: Frost: 'Clear.' Future: 'Certain.' Both: 'You are... fixed. In our sight. Here. Our focus. For you.'

mini_quest.title: The Unclear Future
mini_quest.description: Help the twins clarify a vision by providing a stabilizing presence

stages.hook: Frost: 'A vision.' Future: 'Clouded.' Both: 'Your presence... stabilizes. Help us see?'
stages.active: Frost: 'Stay.' Future: 'Breathe.' Both: 'Let the ice show us.'
stages.complete: Frost: 'We see!' Future: 'The path!' Both: 'Azure's flight. The storm. You. Here. Crystal. Our sight. Yours now.'

cross_npc_connections: aeronaut_blue_frost: Azure. We see him fly. Into white. Into... elsewhere.
aeronaut_white_frost: Cirrus. He will watch. And change. Or end. Both true.
snakecharmer_frost: Warm rock. Elsewhere. Elsewhen. Dangerous. Important.
twins_chrono: Our counterparts. Time twins. We should not meet. Protocol.
